overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met to discuss a draft condominium conversion ordinance designed to regulate rental housing conversions and protect tenants. The committee voted to keep the matter in committee to allow for further consultation with city departments.

items.title: Paper 22-321: Condominium Conversion Ordinance
items.summary: The committee reviewed a draft ordinance that proposes tenant notification periods, relocation payments, and the creation of a condominium review board to oversee permitting. The item was kept in committee pending a decision-points memo and future consultation with the Planning, Development, and Sustainability department and the Building Commissioner.
